name: codyn rank clocks and community dynamics
title: Who swapped places, and do volumes move together?
what: Treat dealers as species: rank clocks show reordering, a variance ratio tests whether volumes co-move, with a persistence-keeping null.
grade: not graded (the 11-12 ad hoc edition predates grading)
pick_line: A share-space variance ratio that is not identically zero, plus a rank-shift null that does not wrap trends.
data: PROXY public FR Y-9C dealer panels (trading assets; big-4 equity trading revenue), not prime brokerage
one: Raw dealer volumes co-move (VR 4.45 vs null 0.44–2.00); foreign IHC volumes do not.

left.sub: variance ratio expected if dealers moved independently (cyclic-shift null mean 1.01)

findings.h: US dealer volumes co-move; the foreign IHCs, alone, do not.
findings.t: Variance ratio on raw trading assets: 4.45 (all 14), 4.43 (US big-6), 0.73 (eight foreign IHCs, inside the null 0.29–2.19). Big-4 equity revenue: 2.36 vs null 0.57–1.66.

chart.title: Variance ratio on raw volumes (1 = independent)

findings.h: The rank clock turns the GS→JPM swap into one picture.
findings.t: Big-4 equity revenue share: GS 52.3% → 23.1%, JPM 14.5% → 43.4% (2011Q1–2026Q2). On trading assets UBS+CS falls from rank 7 to 14.

chart.title: Share of big-4 equity trading revenue, %

findings.h: Our independent port matches codyn exactly (build step 1).
findings.t: All five 11-12 numbers reproduced within 2.2e-5 of their published rounding (≤ 2.7e-15 vs a codyn rerun); SYNTHETIC fixture parity ≤ 4.3e-14. A 999-draw VR null: 0.009 s vs 1.49 s in R (computed).

chart.title: 999-draw VR null on panel A, seconds (lower is better)

findings.h: Honest: the official tools cannot answer the share question.
findings.t: VR on shares is identically 0 (4.07e-17 on panel A), and the wrap-around null inflates mean rank shift on trending series. That is the Math top pick.

findings.h: Build step 2 (2026-11-24): the share-space variance ratio failed its pre-registered test and is dropped.
findings.t: SYNTHETIC 40-quarter, 10-entity panels with a market factor, 1,000 per scenario. The compensation statistic (most negative pairwise correlation after removing the market loading, no-wrap shifted null) has size 0.011 (bar 0.02–0.08) and power 0.226 for a planted sticky swap (bar 0.80). The official VR on shares is 4.4e-17, as expected. The usual raw-volume VR with the wrap null rejects 0.0% / 2.0% (computed).
findings.note: Pre-registered kill rule applied: the library ships raw-volume VR only. No re-run to chase the band.

findings.h: Build step 3: all metrics on 2,000 entities x 40 periods run in 4.6 s in NumPy and about 0.1 s with Numba.
findings.t: 4 vCPU, SYNTHETIC panel, median of 3: NumPy port, all metrics with a 999-draw VR null 4.59 s (bar 5 s); the Numba null 0.076 s against 4.56 s (60x), same draws to 2.7e-14. Rust not needed (computed).
findings.note: The whole 11-12 R edition took 129 s on 14 entities.
